fn-topo-01.back: A line joining points of the same height. Picture the shoreline of a rising lake.

fn-topo-02.back: No. They only touch or merge at a vertical cliff.
fn-topo-02.diagram:

<circle cx="26" cy="26" r="17" fill="#e8590c" stroke="none" stroke-width="2"/><text x="26" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">1</text><text x="52" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">Never cross</text><path d="M40 80 C 150 80, 180 147, 200 147 C 220 147, 250 80, 370 80" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M40 215 C 150 215, 180 153, 200 153 C 220 153, 250 215, 370 215" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M40 245 C 140 248, 260 248, 370 250" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="240" y="152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">touch at a cliff</text><text x="40" y="152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#868e96" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">never cross</text><text x="40" y="285" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">Lines never cross. They only touch at a cliff.</text>
</svg>

fn-topo-03.back: Steep ground. Wide apart means gentle or flat.
fn-topo-03.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="Left: six contour lines packed close together, labelled close equals steep. Right: four lines spread wide, labelled wide equals gentle.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<circle cx="26" cy="26" r="17" fill="#e8590c" stroke="none" stroke-width="2"/><text x="26" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">2</text><text x="52" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">Close is steep</text><line x1="40" y1="70" x2="40" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="54" y1="70" x2="54" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="68" y1="70" x2="68" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="82" y1="70" x2="82" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="70" x2="96" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110" y1="70" x2="110" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="250" y1="70" x2="250" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="286" y1="70" x2="286" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="322" y1="70" x2="322" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="358" y1="70" x2="358" y2="240" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="75" y="262" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Close = steep</text><text x="305" y="262" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#8a9a6b" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Wide = gentle</text>
</svg>

fn-topo-04.back: A thicker line, usually every fifth, with its height printed on it.

fn-topo-05.back: A line every 20 m and a thick index line every 100 m. Feet mode: 40 ft and 200 ft.

fn-topo-06.front: Closed ring with ticks on the inside?
fn-topo-06.back: A depression or hole. The ticks point down into the low spot. Often wet.

fn-topo-07.front: Which way does a contour V point at a creek?
fn-topo-07.back: Upstream, uphill. Water flows out the open end of the V.
fn-topo-07.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="Four contour lines bend into sharp Vs. A blue creek runs through the Vs. The Vs point uphill, upstream, and the water flows out the open end.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<circle cx="26" cy="26" r="17" fill="#e8590c" stroke="none" stroke-width="2"/><text x="26" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">5</text><text x="52" y="32" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">V points upstream</text><path d="M30 100 L170 100 L200 54 L230 100 L370 100" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M30 146 L170 146 L200 100 L230 146 L370 146" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M30 192 L170 192 L200 146 L230 192 L370 192" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M30 238 L170 238 L200 192 L230 238 L370 238" fill="none" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M200 60 L200 276" fill="none" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="200" y1="250" x2="200.0" y2="277.3" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="200.0,285.0 206.1,274.0 193.9,274.0" fill="#4a7fb0"/><text x="262" y="74" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="start" font-weight="bold">V points uphill</text><text x="214" y="284" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#4a7fb0" text-anchor="start">water flows out</text>
</svg>

fn-topo-08.front: Vs pointing uphill, or Us pointing downhill: which is a draw?
fn-topo-08.back: Vs pointing uphill is a draw. Us pointing downhill is a ridge or spur.

fn-topo-09.front: What is a saddle on the map?
fn-topo-09.back: The hourglass of lines between two tops: a low pass where animals cross ridges (65%).

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="A hunter stands on top of a convex slope. A dashed sight line grazes the roll of the hill and passes over the lower slope. The shaded wedge below the sight line, where a deer stands, is hidden dead ground.">

<path d="M0 90 L110 92 C 150 94, 165 100, 175 110 C 195 130, 215 190, 230 230 C 250 270, 300 280, 400 282 L400 300 L0 300 Z" fill="#dfe6d3" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="175,110 400,204 400,282 300,279 260,268 230,230 210,175 190,128" fill="#e8590c" opacity=".2"/><g transform="translate(70 90) scale(0.8)"><circle cx="0" cy="-30" r="7" fill="#2f3a2b"/><path d="M0 -23 V2 M0 2 L-7 18 M0 2 L7 18 M0 -16 L-9 -4 M0 -16 L9 -4" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/></g><line x1="70" y1="66" x2="400" y2="204" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/><g transform="translate(345 270) scale(0.8 0.8)"><ellipse rx="20" ry="9" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M14 -5 L22 -18 L28 -17 L24 -6 Z" fill="#8b5a2b"/><circle cx="25" cy="-19" r="5" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M-12 6 v14 M-6 6 v14 M10 6 v14 M15 6 v14" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3"/></g><text x="285" y="212" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Hidden</text><text x="285" y="230" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">dead ground</text><text x="14" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">From the top of a rolled slope</text><text x="14" y="48" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">you cannot see the bottom.</text>

fn-topo-16.front: Can a 15 m cliff hide on a 20 m contour map?
